title: Ray Barlow, making the game flow.
deck: The passer in the heart of the 1954 team.
body: Ray Barlow’s partnership with Ronnie Allen runs through the club’s accounts of its celebrated 1950s side. Barlow helped shape Albion’s attacking play and, alongside Len Millard, contain Preston’s Tom Finney in the 1954 final.

He later succeeded Millard as captain and led Albion on their 1957 visit to the Soviet Union. The club’s tribute remembers a player whose influence was expressed in passing and judgement, qualities that a goals column cannot capture.
